speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
text: asked	the Minister for Health with recent announcements on the Home Team's counter-terrorism initiatives as well as community plans under SG Secure, whether the Ministry will be coming up with a framework for healthcare institutions pertaining to this.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The day-to-day security operations include surveillance via closed-circuit television (CCTV), patrols and immediate responses to security incidents by security personnel and access controls against unauthorised entry to restricted and sensitive areas.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Our PHIs also conduct security awareness training for their staff so that they remain vigilant and are aware of the basic security measures that they should take.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: PHIs also have contingency plans to step up their vigilance during heightened security alerts.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These include the deployment of additional security personnel, increasing the frequency of patrolling, tightening of access control and stepping up security awareness training among their staff.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For security incidents, like terrorist attacks, the hospital security personnel are expected to contain and manage the situation until the Police arrives at the scene.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) and PHIs also participate in whole-of-Government planning efforts to enhance preparedness for security threats and to share good practices.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The institutions also work directly with the Police land divisions to develop standard operating procedures and conduct familiarisation and emergency drills to test their preparedness and vigilance.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: MOH will work closely with MHA and the Home Team to ensure that our PHIs remain vigilant and alert.

speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
text: First, with the revamp and refinement, can we consider reaching out to all levels of staff, including cleaners and maintenance personnel as well, because these are the people who may pick up suspicious items or activities during the course of their job?
